sources.entry: Time Out - Easy break reminders, with micro-break and flexible customization if you want it. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/time-out-break-reminders/id402592703?platform=mac)

summary.name: Time Out
summary.one_liner: Time Out is a macOS break-reminder app that schedules short micro-breaks and longer normal breaks, with customizable themes, rules, and break actions.
use_cases: Remind yourself to stretch and rest your eyes while working
Skip or postpone breaks during meetings and calls
Schedule lunch or stretch breaks at fixed times
Show calming fullscreen scenes or videos during breaks
Pause music and play a sound when a break starts
Review how often you take breaks over time
summary.what_it_does: Time Out reminds you to step away from your Mac at set intervals, using built-in Normal and Micro breaks that you can adjust in length and frequency, or add custom breaks for lunch or stretching. Breaks can be scheduled at fixed times or around calendar events and limited to certain hours and days, and time away from the Mac counts as a break. Rules can postpone or skip breaks when specific apps run, a calendar event is active, Focus or a fullscreen app is in use, and meeting scripts detect calls in apps such as FaceTime, Teams, and Zoom. Break screens can show themes such as images, videos, web pages, or custom HTML, and Break Actions can adjust volume, play sounds, or run scripts before, during, or after a break.
notable: Core break reminder features are always free, with optional non-renewing Supporter purchases and Premium subscriptions in the App Store edition
Rules skip or postpone breaks during specific apps, calendar events, Focus mode, fullscreen apps, and video calls
Break Actions and themes can be extended with AppleScript, shell, Python, Automator, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
caveats: Premium and supporter features require payment; supporter purchases are 3, 6, or 12-month or lifetime options, and Premium subscriptions are offered only in the App Store edition
Current version 3.1 requires macOS 26.0 or later; an older release 2.9.7 is provided for macOS 10.15 or later
